# mikroconsult

Small digital tools. Listen before you buy.

- Store: https://gama-base.github.io/mikroconsult-ui-sounds/
- Listen: https://gama-base.github.io/mikroconsult-ui-sounds/demo.html
- Gumroad: https://mikroconsult.gumroad.com/

## Sounds (WAV, 44.1 kHz, original, commercial OK)

- Essential — 12 button sounds, $0: https://mikroconsult.gumroad.com/l/free-ui-sounds
- Soft Glass — $1+: https://mikroconsult.gumroad.com/l/glass-ui-sounds
- Crisp Pro — $1+: https://mikroconsult.gumroad.com/l/crisp-ui-sounds
- Retro Soft — $1+: https://mikroconsult.gumroad.com/l/retro-ui-sounds
- Deep Minimal — $1+: https://mikroconsult.gumroad.com/l/minimal-ui-sounds

How-to: Figma https://gama-base.github.io/mikroconsult-ui-sounds/figma-ui-sounds.html
How-to: Godot https://gama-base.github.io/mikroconsult-ui-sounds/godot-ui-sounds.html
